summary: Implemented entry-rank-only grammar compilation and vocab masking for tensor-parallel constrained decoding, with root token broadcast, DP-attention group correctness, and fallbacks for speculative decoding, context parallelism, forced synchronization, and unconstrained batches. Also fixed compile-exception propagation so the true InvalidGrammarObject is retained and cached instead of being mislabeled as a timeout.

tests.command: prepared Python inline baseline reproduction (see raw/baseline_compile_reproduction.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: Before the change, a simulated non-entry TP rank invoked get_cached_or_future_value once and received a Future, reproducing duplicate grammar compilation submission.

97 focused compatibility, regression, and adversarial tests passed, covering compile-once placeholders, cache hits, compile exceptions, failure propagation, PP synchronization payloads, broadcast selection, all-reduce fallback, and no-grammar no-collective behavior.

tests.command: prepared Python inline candidate regression (see raw/candidate_compile_regression.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: After the change, the same simulated non-entry TP rank made zero backend compile/cache lookups and carried a PlaceholderGrammarObject.

tests.command: prepared Python inline two-rank torch.distributed Gloo validation (see raw/two_rank_collective_validation.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: A real two-process call through Sampler._sync_token_ids_across_tp broadcast divergent tokens [3, 9] to [3, 3] from group root 0.

tests.command: prepared Python inline ROCm grammar-mask numerical check (see raw/gpu_mask_numerical_reference.txt)
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X, masked argmax token IDs [2, 1] exactly matched an independently constructed allowed-token reference [2, 1].
No whitespace errors in the contribution.

gpu_execution.evidence: ROCm 7.2 / torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed the grammar-mask numerical check on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950); raw output is retained under reports/j-06841fd1be4d/raw/.

remaining_limitations: Only one GPU was assigned, so true TP=2/TP=4 serving, DP-attention distributed serving, and end-to-end constrained-decoding CPU-overhead benchmarks could not be executed locally.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture is transport/engine-only and cannot create a multi-GPU TP path on the available single GPU, so it was not used as substitute evidence.
Speculative decoding and context parallelism intentionally retain the old compile-and-mask-on-every-rank plus MIN all-reduce path; optimizing those architectures remains outside this candidate.
No native sources changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
